objective: Restore readable centered BUKLOD Main desktop Web Wall feed, show approved top-bar BUKLOD image only once, and keep personal/community conversations and member previews in a contextual right-side panel unless the user explicitly selects Expand.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main source commit aa479f4bb9572977aad1921ba615e488884def31 inspected against user-provided screenshot at buklod.expo.app/buklod; source verification only, NOT live Expo Hosting fingerprint. Production artifact remains independently unverified. This workstream intentionally avoids production release and Android OTA.
chosenApproach: Disable ScrollView flex growing with explicit rail widths, preserve flex center, mount existing BuklodConnectThread in an account-bound right context dock, reuse privacy-aware member loader for profile preview, and intercept only known secondary navigations via transient desktop registration.
selectionRationale: Changing only fixed rail width did not control RN Web ScrollView flex defaults; duplicating a chat engine or using iframes risks permissions, cache, memory and notifications. Existing BuklodConnectThread onBackOverride enables safe in-place dismissal. Member public loader respects locked accounts. The approved PNG has the wordmark already, so standalone extra header wordmark was redundant.
alternativeApproaches: Replace all screens with fullscreen tabs: rejected because it disrupts Main Web continuity.
Implement a second chat UI/RPC: rejected due duplicate state and permission/security risks.
Embed a same-origin iframe for each chat: rejected due duplicate root app, auth, media and realtime subscriptions.
Replace approved B icon with conceptual three-person logo: explicitly rejected by owner.
